patthana23.43:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.43:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana23.43:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika navitakkattike sanidassanattika vitakkattikaṃ
